DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Somatic Type (with themes of special powers/sensorial distortion).

The clinical picture of fixed, false belief in telepathic communication with animals, normal neurological and psychiatric workups, and impaired social functioning is consistent with Delusional Disorder.
